details: v1.2 scans git-tracked files at the frontier branch HEAD, so newly added frontier docs and executables can contribute marker hits.
v1.2 classify() returns ACTIVE_STRUCTURAL_ROUTE when relation == DIRECT_CONTINUATION and any marker surface exists, so that label is not an independent discovery.
v1.2 frontier_score mixes declared relation weight with repository evidence and therefore must not be interpreted as evidence-only proximity to a theorem.

correction.corpus_policy: Enumerate and read only UTF-8 text blobs from the immutable pre-frontier B5.4 evidence tree; frontier branch files cannot increase evidence counts.
correction.marker_policy: Preserve v1.2 case-insensitive literal matching with ASCII identifier boundaries.

ranking_policy.declared_priority_ranking: May use registry relation metadata, but is labeled as prior/priority only.
ranking_policy.evidence_ranking: Must be computed without relation weights from independently classified proof-bearing surfaces.

correction.route_classification_policy: No target may be called ACTIVE merely because its registry relation is DIRECT_CONTINUATION. Proof-bearing hits produce only PROOF_BEARING_ROUTE_SURFACE_FOUND_REQUIRES_THEOREM.
